relations.note: They fly daily across the earth while Óðinn anxiously awaits their return.
They perch on Óðinn’s shoulders, survey the world, and report what they observe.
Óðinn teaches two ravens speech, enabling them to gather and report intelligence.

relations.myth: Flights toward the hanged and slain
relations.note: They depart Hnikarr’s shoulders, Huginn toward hanged people and Muninn toward corpses.

relations.myth: Watchers and messengers in the Ring
relations.note: Two ravens act as Wotan’s watchers and messengers in Wagner’s dramatic cycle.
They receive Brünnhilde’s news and carry it home to Wotan.
At Brünnhilde’s direction, they prompt Loge’s fire to consume Valhalla.
